_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05. Do NOT edit seed.json. Specs pulled from Bugaboo's official Fox 5 Renew spec page (identical stroller to the standard Fox 5; Renew uses recycled materials). Clek's official list Fox row covers Fox/Fox2/Fox3/Fox5 — the current-generation Fox 5 is sourced here.
name: Bugaboo Fox 5 (covers Fox / Fox2 / Fox3 / Fox5)

clekListed.clekRow: Bugaboo | Fox / Fox2 / Fox3 / Fox5 | Bugaboo Fox/Lynx/Buffalo Adapter for Maxi-Cosi | 441200MC01 or 231100MC02

specs._weightNote: Bugaboo lists 12.3 kg (~27.1 lb) fully assembled with seat; 13.3 kg (~29.3 lb) with bassinet. Amazon lists 27.0 lb. Some third-party summaries cite a lower chassis-only figure.
specs._unfoldedNote: Bugaboo in-use: 93 x 60 x 105 cm = 36.6 x 23.6 x 41.3 in. Adjustable handlebar 92-108 cm (36.2-42.5 in).
specs._foldedNote: One-piece self-standing fold 45 x 60 x 90 cm = 17.3 x 23.6 x 35.4 in. Two-piece compact fold 89 x 53 x 34 cm = 35 x 20.9 x 13.4 in.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (0 mo) — 2-in-1 with lie-flat bassinet (bassinet limit 20 lb / 9 kg) and reversible reclining seat; usable to ~4 yrs

specs._capacityNote: Max child height not published by Bugaboo. Underseat basket 10 kg (22 lb) / 45 L.

safety.standards: Not published on Bugaboo's Fox 5 spec page. Sold in the US, so it must meet the mandatory federal stroller standard 16 CFR 1227 (incorporates ASTM F833) to be marketed; EU units carry EN 1888. No explicit standard printed by the manufacturer, so not asserted as certified.
safety.certifications: No JPMA or Greenguard certification published for the Fox 5 on the manufacturer or retailer pages reviewed.
safety.notes: 5-point harness; reversible seat with multi-position recline; full suspension; extendable UPF 50+ canopy; one-hand fold. Adapter-mounted infant car seats limited to 28.7 lb child weight.

recall.source: CPSC/SaferProducts + Bugaboo product-recalls page; no recall listed for the Bugaboo Fox (Fox/Fox2/Fox3/Fox5)

specs.foldType: one-hand fold (seat or bassinet on frame); self-standing one-piece fold plus two-piece ultra-compact fold
specs.recline: multi-position reclinable seat (both facing directions); bassinet gives full lie-flat for newborns
specs.tires: extra-large puncture-proof foam-filled wheels with full suspension; front ~8.5 in, rear ~12 in; front swivel with lock

notes: Current-generation Bugaboo Fox (Fox 5 / Fox 5 Renew); Clek's Fox row covers Fox/Fox2/Fox3/Fox5, all of which take the same Fox/Lynx/Buffalo Maxi-Cosi adapter (441200MC01, alternate 231100MC02) — adapter-441200mc01. FULL-SIZE all-terrain 2-in-1: ~27 lb, 8.5 in front / 12 in rear puncture-proof wheels, full suspension, reversible lie-flat-capable seat, bassinet included. This is a premium full-size pram, NOT a compact/city stroller — it does not meet a lightweight city-travel goal (folded is bulky; two-piece compact fold still ~35 x 20.9 x 13.4 in and heavy). Best cited price $1,299 (Swaddles Baby, standard Fox 5 Complete) vs $1,499 Renew DTC/Strolleria. Clek Liing mounts via the Maxi-Cosi-footprint adapter.
